a comprehensive model of the operational maintenance process, linked with a Blocker Resolution Process, can be used to improve the performance of the system and to identify safety issues that may otherwise be overlooked.
a performance reporting and blocker resolution process for aircraft maintenance checks can improve the current check process and reduce the number of defects.

the development of a new performance improvement model for aircraft maintenance.
the development of an innovative solution to the challenge of improving the performance of aircraft maintenance without compromising safety and efficiency.
how to improve the performance of aircraft maintenance checks, and the implications this has for hazard identification.

the Blocker Report and Blocker Resolution Process is a valuable tool for improving performance, safety and efficiency in aircraft maintenance.
the model developed in this research provides a framework to identify and address blockers in a system and that this approach can be used in other industries.
a Blocker Report, the Blocker Resolution Process and the associated performance model are effective tools for improving aircraft maintenance processes.

the Blocker Report and Blocker Resolution Process are a valuable addition to the safety toolbox of an aviation maintenance company.
